name: code-context-native
description: Fast local code search, source reads, and context for AI agents. Native VS Code tools backed by one shared, adaptive cache.

codeContextNative.socketPath.description: Absolute code-context daemon socket path. Empty uses CCTX_HOME or ~/.local/state/code-context/daemon.sock.

codeContextNative.autoStartService.description: Start code-context.service through systemctl --user when the daemon socket is unavailable.

codeContextNative.wslDistribution.description: Windows extension hosts: WSL distribution running the shared daemon. Native IPC uses wsl.exe, not MCP or TCP.

codeContextNative.wslExecutablePath.description: Windows extension hosts: absolute Linux cctx executable supporting native-bridge. Supply an explicit Linux root in Agent Sessions.

codeContextNative.autoRegisterWorkspace.description: Initialize trusted unregistered workspace folders on the first source lookup, never during window reload. Disable to require manual registration.

codeContextNative.executablePath.description: Absolute cctx executable path used for interactive workspace registration. Empty uses ~/.local/bin/cctx.

codeContextNative.requestTimeoutMs.description: Native tool request timeout in milliseconds.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeFiles
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this FIRST for filename/path glob discovery, NOT content. This native tool is an optional root cache. CACHE_MISS returns immediately and schedules only this root; continue with permitted host search/read, not polling, repeated CCTX calls, another CCTX transport or code_sync. A miss is not zero matches. If foreground host dispatch is unavailable, prefer backend MCP code_files; do not repeat pending calls. Respects registration and exclusions.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find indexed filenames and paths without searching file contents.

root.description: Optional registered root. Windows Agent Sessions: pass the actual absolute Linux project/worktree root.

glob.description: Filename or relative-path glob, e.g. *Tools.ts, *.json or src/**/*.rs.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeGrep
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this FIRST for saved-source exact/regex search with path/glob filters. This native tool is an optional root cache. CACHE_MISS returns immediately and schedules only this root; continue with permitted host search/read, not polling, repeated CCTX calls, another CCTX transport or code_sync. A miss is not zero matches. If foreground host dispatch is unavailable, prefer backend MCP code_grep; do not repeat pending calls.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search indexed workspace source with the native Rust code-context tool.

root.description: Optional registered root. Windows Agent Sessions: pass the actual absolute Linux project/worktree root.

pattern.description: Literal substring by default, not semantic or keyword search. Set regex=true for alternation such as a|b or other regex syntax.

regex.description: Enable regular expressions explicitly; otherwise |, parentheses and other operators are literal characters.

paths.description: Optional relative file or directory prefixes.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeContext
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this FIRST for symbol/literal/regex lookup with nearby saved source in one native call. This tool is an optional root cache. CACHE_MISS returns immediately and schedules only this root; continue with permitted host search/read, not polling, repeated CCTX calls, another CCTX transport or code_sync. A miss is not zero matches. If foreground host dispatch is unavailable, prefer backend MCP code_context; do not repeat pending calls.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search indexed source and return versioned surrounding context.

root.description: Optional registered root. Windows Agent Sessions: pass the actual absolute Linux project/worktree root.

pattern.description: Literal substring by default, not semantic or keyword search. Set regex=true for alternation such as a|b or other regex syntax.

regex.description: Enable regular expressions explicitly; otherwise |, parentheses and other operators are literal characters.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeRead
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use this for known saved-source ranges and live-verified hashes in a native batch read. This tool is an optional root cache. CACHE_MISS returns immediately and schedules only this root; continue with permitted host search/read, not polling, repeated CCTX calls, another CCTX transport or code_sync. A miss is not a missing disk file. If foreground host dispatch is unavailable, prefer backend MCP code_read; do not repeat pending calls.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read multiple indexed source ranges with live hash verification.

root.description: Optional registered root. Windows Agent Sessions: pass the actual absolute Linux project/worktree root.

page.description: Use for large reads. Returns explicit snippets,complete,next_ranges under256KiB. Continue page=true with next_ranges;compare file hashes across pages. false keeps atomic snippet-array output.

split_ranges.description: Split broad reads into explicitly returned snippets of at most500lines; max64segments and256KiBtotal. false keeps strict500line input ranges.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeStatus
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show native code-context index state, coverage, memory and protocol counters without loading, refreshing or hashing source. An unloaded index is normal until the first source lookup.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Show native index and daemon status.

root.description: Optional registered root. Windows Agent Sessions: pass the actual absolute Linux project/worktree root.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeSync
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the preferred native explicit full-source synchronization barrier before exhaustive absence claims or after edits. Rechecks ignore/profile policy and updates only changed postings.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Synchronize the native source index with saved files.

root.description: Optional registered root. Windows Agent Sessions: pass the actual absolute Linux project/worktree root.

languageModelTools.name: code-context-native_codeWorkspaces
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List explicitly registered native code-context roots, scopes, globs, exclusion settings, and memory policies. Use only when automatic current-workspace root resolution is ambiguous.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Code Context
walkthroughs.description: A local context engine for your AI agent. Connect once, then search, read, and gather source context.

steps.title: 1. Install the local engine
steps.description:
The extension connects to cctx, a shared Rust engine running on Linux or WSL. It never silently downloads or installs an executable.
[Open setup guide](command:codeContextNative.openSetupGuide)

steps.title: 2. Choose your connection
steps.description:
Linux, WSL, and SSH workspace hosts use a Unix socket. Windows Agent Sessions use your chosen WSL distribution and the Linux cctx executable.
[Configure connection](command:codeContextNative.configureConnection)

steps.title: 3. Check readiness
steps.description:
Trust your workspace, register it with the backend, and verify the native tools. On Windows Agent Sessions, use an explicit Linux root with source tools; the self-test needs an unambiguous root.
[Run native self-test](command:codeContextNative.selfTest)

steps.title: 4. Put context to work
steps.description:
Enable the Code Context tools in your agent's tool settings. Try #cctxNativeFiles or #cctxNativeContext. A cold cache returns CACHE_MISS immediately: continue with normal tools while it loads only the requested root.
[View status](command:codeContextNative.showStatus)

scripts.package: npm run clean && npm run lint && npm test && vsce package --baseContentUrl https://github.com/dotnetpower/code-context/blob/main/vscode-extension --baseImagesUrl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dotnetpower/code-context/main/vscode-extension --out dist/code-context-native.vsix
